signing.tauriUpdaterKey: mandatory; private key only in GitHub secrets
signing.windows: unsigned until a code-signing certificate/Azure Artifact Signing is available; release body carries SmartScreen warning

versionSource: git tag vX.Y.Z; package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and src-tauri/Cargo.toml are asserted equal in the release job
release: CI auto-publish is an explicit project choice; release job waits for frontend + rust tests; publish job validates updater feed, writes LF SHA256SUMS, creates attestation, publishes with make_latest, then anonymously verifies latest.json

deviations.reason: README and CI scope: Windows 10/11 x64 only; Rust side and tools/*.cmd/*.ps1 contain Windows-specific behavior, and no macOS/Linux/arm64 test hardware is available.
deviations.revisitWhen: a macOS/Linux/arm64 user request appears, or the Windows-specific tooling is made cross-platform

deviations.reason: No Windows code-signing certificate/Azure Artifact Signing is available yet; release notes carry the SmartScreen warning.
deviations.revisitWhen: Azure Artifact Signing or a Windows signing certificate becomes available

deviations.reason: Operator explicitly chose CI auto-publish in commit 45cfe60 instead of leaving a draft for a manual click; release is still gated by frontend + rust tests and the publish job feed/checksum/attestation checks.
deviations.revisitWhen: first release that would have been stopped by human approval, or when protected-environment approval is added

notes: audit.mjs reads platforms and deviations only. Every deviation has reason + revisitWhen. release-auto-publish documents the deliberate auto-publish choice. Everything else is guidance.
